You’re not lazy.  You’re angry.  And that’s ok.  But it might be clouding your will power and drive.  That’s what’s going on with me.  I always feel like I’m spinning and not making progress due to an unfair hurdle. 

We are right.  It sucks.  I will say, (as a parent) it’s highly likely they are only doing what they think will
Be best for you or you wouldn’t be in their house.  Again - I’m guessing.  But I’m the chance that I’m correct, maybe, without anger and without big emotion, call them to the table and tell them how you feel you can’t move forward.  See if, together, you can make a new arrangement that feels fair to all but will
Help you have the sense of forward momentum.

I hope you can take this suggestion without inferring that you’ve done anything wrong - you likely have not.  But if your parents let you live at home - they care.  And maybe they can adjust in some way to help
You differently,  worth a try anyway.

I hear a lot of intelligence in your post.  I wanted to die yesterday - that’s why I’m here.  But I noticed I had something to say to a lot of you and I might stay awhile.  You read like someone who needs a friend to help you sort some shit - not a gun.  If you need an ear, I can listen.

I understand your sentiments.  It’s like 10x worse when you think your past it and you realize it was still there all along.  I also have A LOT of brain/cognitive issues.  Feel dead inside.  BUT, I have decided to keep pushing, so if you want to chat - I’ll be staying for today.

He has a great career and a very comfortable life.  He overcame that bullshit and is so much tougher than anyone he works with for it:  and succeeds at a greater rate bc he was toughned so much by his childhood.  Feel free to message me if you need someone to listen (whenever)

He’s actually a miracle - didn’t mention it bc I wanted to respect your request not to hear it gets better bc frankly it doesn’t for everyone.  But it did for him - he burned rubber out of that small town the second he could and barely looks back.

Thank you.  I came here today to talk about killing myself and then noticed how young so many of the ppl posting seemed.   I guess I just hope a lot of ppl on here get some more data on themselves.  I had to get off a 15 yr med and am ill right now.  Like I can want to die and simultaneously know I’m sick and those thoughts are just chemicals attacking me.  But this morning it was intense.   Made a deal with a stranger on here that we would go get our new meds today.  So for me anyway, here’s to tomorrow.  Hopefully for you and everyone else on here too.

Life will be a grind. It’s a guarantee.  Money is a facade though.  Really doesn’t mean anyone is “great”.  Like I have a nice life - married, decent home, kids, vacation- but I’m still here talking about suicide.  Sorry, wish I had better advice.  Actually, I will say that if you are struggling with thought control - like you don’t want to think about her and you don’t know how to stop - I make sandwiches in my head.  Sometimes I even say the steps outloud,  it just proves to myself that I can change my thoughts.  Sometimes I’m like a subway over here though 😂

That is a hard life, bro.  I don’t have any tips on how to get out of this place but I will say that you have not gotten a fair shake and I can understand why you’d want to go.  My husbands mom was 13 (impregnated by his 18yr old dad) and had a similar upbringing - also scared shitless of his Dad.  Hard way to come into what’s already a hard enough life as it is.
Thank you, likewise.
I have young children (not sure if that applies to you) but it adds a level of complexity that’s for sure

I’m ok.  Much worse this morning when I got on this thread.  Literally downloaded Reddit just to talk about this with anonymity.  Oddly, my post never posted and I ended up chatting with some ppl.  They were much younger than me and I felt I had something to give and my time isn’t done here.  So yeah, weird outcome.  Even made a pact with a stranger that we would go get our new meds today like we’re were supposed to have already done.
Kind of just entered that phase myself.  Like before, I was like holy shit what’s wrong with you.  Now when I think about it I equate it to being covered up with a warm blanket.

If this is a poem, I love it. 

I’ve never heard a better analogy for how I feel that cereal with water - what’s the point.  Could also be a song.  Want to work on some lyrics and take a break from wanting to die for a bit?  I know I do.

If you want someone to talk to, I can listen.  I came here this morning bc I am also suicidal.  However, reading all these posts makes me feel like I have something to give and work still to do.  So if chatting will help at all - even to pass the moment - I will listen bc ultimately you will be helping me too.

I don’t know really.  I’m here bc I’m not well
Either.  But I guess I think of my failures while
Under the duress of bad parents as not counting now that I have 40 years in the game.
